nodes.label: Multi-Pair Equity Curve Real
nodes.description: Real forex equity curves for 8 currency pairs over ~2 years (~200 trades). Title: 'Equity curves всех 8 пар — РЕАЛЬНЫЕ данные за ~2 года. Жёсткая правда о бэктесте на одной паре vs. multi-pair'. Shows cumulative return in % on Y-axis vs trade number on X-axis. Pairs include EURUSD (+11.78), GBPUSD (+9.98), AUDUSD (+7.55), NZDUSD (+14.5B), USDJPY (+5.36), USDCAD (+23.5B), EURJPY (-20.5B), GBPJPY (+33.4B). Some pairs show significant drawdowns (reaching -20%), demonstrating the difference in risk/reward between single-pair and multi-pair backtesting.

nodes.label: Multi-Pair Backtesting Concept
nodes.description: Educational concept illustrated: backtesting on a single currency pair vs. multi-pair portfolio diverges significantly in real data, with individual pairs showing widely different equity trajectories.
